public static final DeferredHolder<EntityType<?>, EntityType<HammerProjectile>> HAMMER_PROJECTILE = ENTITY_TYPES.register("hammer_projectile",
            () -> EntityType.Builder.<HammerProjectile>of(HammerProjectile::new, MobCategory.MISC).sized(0.35F, 0.35F).clientTrackingRange(4).updateInterval(10).build("hammer_projectile"));

rows.concrete_observation: Native item use onserver sets configurable item cooldown/durability for noncreative then creates HammerProjectile with owner and adds to level; named Jeb affects only texture. Native server EntityHit directly launchTarget and broadcasts70; client predicts EntityHit by sending target/projectile IDs in HammerProjectileLaunchPacket and independently spawns particles. Block hit iterates inflated AABB5 (not a spherical distance test), server launches each and client sends each ID pair; server then one event70. launch excludes owner and owner current vehicle, only Living hurt7 then direct push(deltaX,0.6,deltaZ) without reading hurt result. Projectile onHit separately broadcasts3 and discards. tick counts nongrounded air ticks to >500 server discard and NBT persists count. Explicit registered C2S launch handler body is absent in selected cache.
rows.application_to_boss_immune: Impact particles are contact prediction/lifecycle, not proof target health/control admitted. Final hurtfalse cannot guard direct push. Do not infer C2S authority, distance/owner validation or duplicate application from packet name alone.
rows.semantic_dedup: Zero: hurt-result-independent direct push is already covered in several master families; missing HammerProjectileLaunchPacket prevents closing alternate request ingress. Air lifetime, Jeb texture, owner constant filter, event70/3 and registry wrappers are not additional implementations.
rows.limitations: Static only; no original Projectile collision implementation or C2S handler read, no damage/control/network result validated. Do not claim server+client request necessarily doubles damage or permits arbitrary targeting.

public static final DeferredHolder<EntityType<?>, EntityType<ValkyrieQueen>> VALKYRIE_QUEEN = ENTITY_TYPES.register("valkyrie_queen",
            () -> EntityType.Builder.of(ValkyrieQueen::new, MobCategory.MONSTER).sized(0.8F, 1.95F).fireImmune().clientTrackingRange(10).build("valkyrie_queen"));

rows.concrete_observation: Actual registered Queen inherits AbstractValkyrie.registerGoals adding teleport goal, but overrides teleportAroundTarget to 7-block candidate clamped to dungeon room before common teleport(x,y,z). Common method calls AetherEventDispatch then returnsfalse on event canceled; otherwise randomTeleport uses event-modified target coordinates and emits event70 only on returnedtrue. Client70 calls movement explosion helper five times. Native goal postincrements timer; if old timer<450 returns, success resets random0..39, failure subtracts20 from already incremented timer. No claim of exact real-time interval because execution schedule not run. Parent hurt adds aggro only if super hurt returnedtrue. Parent regular-valkyrie floor-tag check is bypassed by Queen override and cannot be attributed to Queen.
rows.application_to_boss_immune: Distinguish control-veto/result, retry scheduling and success-only cue; use dynamic dispatch to identify actual qualification. Event target replacement is consumed unlike implementations ignoring event coordinates.
rows.semantic_dedup: Zero proposal: success-gated teleport cue overlaps master goety-voidrobe-actual-teleport-success-gates-dodge and other final teleport gate families; timer/random-range variants alone do not justify credit. AetherEventDispatch/ValkyrieTeleportEvent and EntityUtil internals absent. Preserve native goal/override context as support rather than rebrand same gate.
rows.limitations: No event publication internals, vanilla randomTeleport or movement particle geometry read. Boss room is external Nitrogen API. No GUI, AI or TCP executed; no immunity text/sound asserted.

source_refs.excerpt: public static final DeferredItem<Item> INVISIBILITY_CLOAK = ITEMS.register("invisibility_cloak", () -> new InvisibilityCloakItem(new Item.Properties().stacksTo(1).rarity(AETHER_LOOT)));
AccessoriesAPI.registerAccessory(AetherItems.INVISIBILITY_CLOAK.get(), (Accessory) AetherItems.INVISIBILITY_CLOAK.get());

rows.concrete_observation: Registered Accessory cloak client toggle calls setSynched SERVER for enabled flag; server tick balances wearing flag against attacked flag and config, then separately toggles vanilla invisible and emits registered SetInvisibilityPacket to all players. Native client initialization registers RenderPlayer.Pre and RenderArm subscribers: both suppress rendering from wearing flag, not by testing vanilla isInvisible; canceled prior event stays canceled. Unequip requests wearingfalse, sets invisiblefalse and calls vanilla visibility-update accessor. Attachment server cooldown decrements only while attacked flagtrue, clears via setSynched when<=0; idle resets config budget. Native LivingVisibility subscriber calls preventTargeting/recentlyAttacked helper; latter can multiply visibility1, which by itself is not proof undoing previous0 or clearing an already selected mob target.
rows.application_to_boss_immune: Keep target eligibility, vanilla invisible flag, body/arm rendering and actual damage/control admission distinct. Removing one visible flag is not complete recovery proof. Whole-body suppression may hide a desired world-space feedback anchor; do not infer immunity from missing model.
rows.semantic_dedup: Zero: complete policy/packet and Nitrogen sync internals missing; generic status-to-render-cancel family is not new merely because named cloak. AbilityHooks absent prevents claims of actual target exclusion and of how attacked flag is produced. Two render callbacks and synced setter wrappers remain one support chain.
rows.limitations: No SetInvisibilityPacket decode/execute or LivingEntityAccessor body read. No guarantee data sync/local body consistency, active potion restoration, distance authorization or server flags immediately mutated by setSynched. No invisibility makes invulnerable claim.
